description: This file defines a custom React hook named useLongPressEvent, which handles long press events on a DOM element using pointer events and timers. It manages event listeners for pointer down, move, cancel, and up events, and invokes a listener callback after a specified delay when a long press is detected.

methods.name: useLongPressEvent
methods.description: A custom React hook that sets up long press event handling on a DOM element ref, invoking a callback after a delay when a long press is detected.
